title: Achuar-Shiwiar language
description: Chicham language spoken in Peru and Ecuador
extract: Shiwiar, also known as Jivaro and Maina, is a Chicham language spoken along the Pastaza and Bobonaza rivers in Ecuador. Shiwiar is one of the thirteen indigenous languages of Ecuador. All of these Indigenous languages are endangered.
